name: model_op_fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode
description: Single-token GDN decode step with fused gating, straight off the packed QKV projection (vllm/model_executor/layers/fla/ops/fused_recurrent.py fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode). mixed_qkv [B, 2*H*K + HV*V] float16/bfloat16/float32 packs q, k and v back to back; a, b [B, HV] and A_log, dt_bias [HV] drive the fused gate (g = -exp(A_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias) with a 20.0 linear threshold, beta = sigmoid(b) rounded through b's dtype); initial_state [num_slots, HV, V, K] is the paged recurrent state, indexed per sequence by ssm_state_indices [B] int32. For each sequence the slot state is decayed by exp(g), corrected by the delta rule against k, rank-1 updated, read out with q into out [B, 1, HV, V], and written back to the same slot. Slots with index <= 0 (NULL_BLOCK_ID / PAD_SLOT_ID) write zeros to out and leave the state untouched. q and k are L2-normalized in the kernel when use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel is set. Both out and initial_state are mutated in place and returned.
